title: Building Bitcoin from Scratch Using Assembly and C
nextTopics: Next modules: SHA-256 known-answer checks through Framework; complete block-header vectors; compact targets; Merkle trees; transaction parsing; scripts and signatures; UTXO validation; regtest messages; storage and reorganisation; measured Assembly optimisation. readingNote: Read in order. Concepts can be studied without installation; optional programming exercises require the named language tools. Available lessons form an opening module, not a completed course.
